title: All-dimensional weighted third-prefix inequality
statement: For every n>=3 and every real unit-diagonal SPD A with mu=lambda_min(A), the exact weighted prefix matrix C_3(A)=J_3(A)-(1/2)J_2(A) satisfies C_3(A)>=(2mu/n)A^{-1}. The explicit sufficient state L_3 satisfies the same bound.
assumptions: mu is the normalized spectral floor
open_objections: The W4 and growing-depth Schur-recovery steps remain open.
No priority audit, Lean formalization, or external-human validation exists.
